result.brief: 提出多人全景动作条件世界模型 PAWA：构建同步 POV-全景视频与动作数据集及分布式采集渲染管线，设计双塔模型经跨注意力在世界坐标系对齐同向 token，并引入二次相位玩家编码。
result.reason: Action-conditioned multiplayer world model with dual-tower POV/panoramic video prediction, cross-attention token alignment and new player encoding; dataset and pipeline contributions.
